title: Choose a capture’s media type
responsibility: Chooses an allowed media type from the capture kind, recorded type and byte signatures.

inputs.name: artifactMedia.capture
inputs.description: The capture kind and recorded media type: kind must be screenshot, audio, output, assertions or trace, and any other kind is refused. mediaType is read only for audio, where it must be a recorded audio type the function knows, and for output, assertions and trace, where application/json (parameters after ';' ignored) lets text that parses as JSON be served as application/json.

inputs.name: artifactMedia.bytes
inputs.description: The raw bytes to inspect: a screenshot needs a PNG or JPEG signature at the start, audio needs the signature of its recorded type, and an output, assertions or trace result must decode as UTF-8 with no null character. The length is not limited here, and the screenshot and audio checks read only the leading bytes.

outputs.name: artifactLimit
outputs.description: The most raw bytes one artifact may have, 11 MiB or 11,534,336 bytes, so that its base64 form still fits one 16 MiB message. The limit is only exported; artifactMedia does not check byte length against it.

outputs.name: artifactMedia
outputs.description: The media type the capture is served as: image/png or image/jpeg for screenshots, audio/wav, audio/mpeg, audio/mp4 or audio/ogg for audio, and application/json or text/plain; charset=utf-8 for results. A result is application/json only when its recorded type is application/json (parameters ignored) and its text parses as JSON, and nothing is ever served as HTML or anything a page would run.

errors.name: type-not-attested
errors.description: Refused with a thrown plain Error when the capture kind is not screenshot, audio, output, assertions or trace, when screenshot bytes are not PNG or JPEG, when the recorded audio type is not one the function knows or its bytes do not match it, or when a result is not valid UTF-8 or contains a null character. Invalid JSON is not refused; it is served as plain text.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The plain Error that artifactMedia throws synchronously for every refused input, with a message that names the case: an unsupported capture kind, screenshot bytes that are not PNG or JPEG, a recorded audio type the function does not know, audio bytes that do not match their type, or a result that is not valid UTF-8 or contains a null character.
